buffett.label: Extreme
buffett.description: Total US market cap (Wilshire 5000) vs GDP — Warren Buffett's "best single measure." Percentile-ranked over the last 10 years.
buffett.title: Buffett Indicator
buffett.subtitle: Market Cap / GDP

shiller.label: Extreme
shiller.description: S&P 500 price divided by 10-year inflation-adjusted earnings. Percentile-ranked over the last 10 years.
shiller.title: Shiller CAPE
shiller.subtitle: 10-Year Real P/E

fed_model.label: Extreme
fed_model.description: S&P earnings yield 3.13% vs 10Y Treasury 4.55%. Positive spread means stocks are relatively cheap vs bonds.
fed_model.title: Fed Model
fed_model.subtitle: Earnings Yield − 10Y

breadth.label: Elevated
breadth.description: 291 of 501 S&P 500 stocks trading above their 200-day moving average. Healthy markets see 50–75%; above 90% signals euphoric participation.
breadth.title: Breadth
breadth.subtitle: % S&P 500 > 200-DMA

fear_greed.label: Fair
fear_greed.description: CNN's composite of 7 short-term sentiment signals (momentum, breadth, put/call ratio, junk-bond demand, volatility, etc.). High readings reflect investor euphoria — historically a contrarian sell signal.
fear_greed.title: Fear & Greed
fear_greed.subtitle: CNN Sentiment Index

vix.label: Elevated
vix.description: 30-day expected S&P 500 volatility implied by options. Low readings (under 15) signal complacency and often coincide with frothy markets; high readings (over 30) signal fear and frequently mark short-term bottoms.
vix.title: VIX
vix.subtitle: Implied Volatility
